summary.headline: Jupiter in Virgo and Libra
summary.text: Predictions for Jupiter’s movement toward Virgo and entry into Libra, covering rains, winds, crops, health, markets, rulers, travelers, pregnant women, and religious life. Bozorgmehr Bakhtegan, Democritus, Hermes, Ahmad Abd al-Jalil, Taj al-Din Akram, and Haseb Ki give differing judgments by direction.
